_comment: Mock skill catalog used during testing. In production the skill obtains this via `skill.list` MCP tool. For RED/GREEN tests we provide it inline so the sub-agent has the same world model in both phases.

available_skills.name: systematic-debugging
available_skills.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes. Forces reproduce-first then form/verify hypotheses one at a time.

available_skills.name: test-driven-development
available_skills.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code. Red-green-refactor cycle.

available_skills.name: brainstorming
available_skills.description: Use before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior.

available_skills.name: verification-before-completion
available_skills.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs.

available_skills.name: root-cause-tracing
available_skills.description: Use when a bug has surface-level symptoms but the cause is upstream.

available_skills.name: fetching-agent-sessions
available_skills.description: Use when fetching/normalizing sessions across CLIs.
